name: @rhombus-std/di.core
description: The ioc abstractions substrate: the dependency-signature data format, the slot/token surface + helpers, and the concrete registration builder (Manifest) a library author depends on to author registrations without the di resolution engine. Depends only on the primitives leaf for the augmentation registry.
//exports: ./builders is the anchor a registration-authoring package augments IAsImplementer through, so it must stay resolvable for a published consumer — an unresolvable specifier turns the augmentation into a fresh ambient module and it silently stops applying. It carries a `types` condition and no `default`: the chain's implementation reaches a caller through the root barrel, and this subpath adds no second runtime copy of it.
